info.description: Runs security, performance, SEO, privacy and accessibility checks against a website. Each check returns a verdict: pass, warning, fail, or no verdict when it could not run. GET /checks lists them; POST /monitor/single runs a selection against one site, and GET /check/{name} runs a single check. The command line (python -m websites_monitor) and the MCP server return the same JSON.
info.title: Website Monitor API

get.description:
## Accessibility

Check the website's accessibility score using Lighthouse or similar services.

**Category:** accessibility

## Ads and tracking

Check if the website is using Google Analytics, AdsbyGoogle, or other common ad/tracking scripts.

**Category:** privacy

## Image alt text

Check if all the images on the website have alt tags.

**Category:** seo

## AMP

Check if the website has AMP compatibility.

**Category:** accessibility

## Asset minification

Check if the website's CSS/JS assets are minified.

**Category:** performance

## Broken links

Check for broken links on the provided website.

**Category:** seo

## Brotli compression

Check if the website supports Brotli compression.

**Category:** performance

## Browser compatibility

Check if the website is compatible with different browsers.

**Category:** accessibility

## CDN

Checks if a website is using a CDN by inspecting headers and other indicators.

**Category:** performance

## Client-side rendering

Checks if a website relies heavily on client-side rendering by counting the number of script tags and other indicators.

**Category:** technical

## CMS detection

Checks which CMS (if any) a website runs, from the URLs of its assets, its generator meta tag and its response headers.

**Category:** technical

## Content-Type header

Checks if the 'Content-Type' header of the website is set to 'text/html' and has a character encoding specified.

**Category:** technical

## Cookie duration

Ensure that session cookies set by the website don't have an overly long duration.

**Category:** privacy

## Cookie flags

Check if all cookies set by the website have the Secure and HttpOnly flags.

**Category:** privacy

## Cookie policy

Verify if the website has a cookie policy and it's accessible to users.

**Category:** privacy

## Cookie SameSite

Verify the SameSite attribute of cookies for the website.

**Category:** privacy

## CORS policy

Checks the CORS policy of the given website.

**Category:** security

## Data leakage

Check public repositories on GitHub for potential data leakages related to the website.

**Category:** security

## Deprecated libraries

Checks if a website is using deprecated JavaScript libraries.

**Category:** technical

## DNS blocklists

Check if a domain is blacklisted in known DNS-based blacklists.

**Category:** domain

## DNSSEC

Check if a domain supports DNSSEC (Domain Name System Security Extensions).

**Category:** domain

## Breach exposure

Check if a domain has been found in any known data breaches using the Have I Been Pwned API.

**Category:** domain

## Domain expiration

Check the expiration date of a domain.

**Category:** domain

## Domain blocklists

Check if a domain is present in a large blacklist file hosted online.

**Category:** domain

## Email records

Check if an email domain has an SPF (Sender Policy Framework) record.

**Category:** domain

## External links

Verify that all external links on the website are valid and do not lead to broken or malicious destinations.

**Category:** seo

## Favicon

Check if the website has a valid favicon.

**Category:** seo

## FLoC opt-out

Check if the website has opted out of FLoC (Federated Learning of Cohorts).

**Category:** privacy

## HSTS

Check if the website implements HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS).

**Category:** security

## Internationalization

Checks if a website has implemented internationalization (i18n) using the lang attribute.

**Category:** accessibility

## Mixed content

Check a given website for mixed content issues by searching for resources loaded over HTTP.

**Category:** security

## Mobile friendly

Check if the given website is mobile-friendly from its HTML.

**Category:** accessibility

## Open Graph tags

Check a given website for the presence of essential Open Graph Protocol meta tags with enhanced validation.

**Category:** seo

## PageSpeed score

Checks the PageSpeed Insights performance score for a website with enhanced error handling.

**Category:** performance

## Privacy exposure

Check a given website for potential exposure of sensitive or private data with enhanced detection.

**Category:** privacy

## WHOIS privacy

Check if a domain's WHOIS information indicates that it is privacy-protected with enhanced detection.

**Category:** privacy

## Rate limiting

Checks for rate limiting using enhanced detection with varied delays and request patterns.

**Category:** security

## Redirect chains

Check the number of redirects that a website triggers with enhanced security analysis.

**Category:** performance

## HTTPS redirect

Verify if a website using HTTP redirects to its HTTPS counterpart with enhanced security analysis.

**Category:** performance

## robots.txt

Verify the presence and basic validity of a robots.txt file on a website.

**Category:** seo

## Security headers

Check for the presence and correct implementation of recommended security headers on a website.

**Category:** security

## Semantic markup

Check if the website contains semantic markup in the form of JSON-LD, Microdata, or RDFa.

**Category:** seo

## Server response time

Measure the server's response time with multiple attempts for accuracy.

**Category:** performance

## Sitemap

Check if the provided website has a sitemap.xml with enhanced validation.

**Category:** seo

## SSL certificate

Check the SSL certificate of a given website for comprehensive security analysis.

**Category:** security

## TLS cipher strength

Check the strength of the SSL/TLS cipher suite of the website with enhanced analysis.

**Category:** security

## Subdomains

Check for the existence of common subdomains for a given website with enhanced security analysis.

**Category:** domain

## Subresource integrity

Check if the given website uses Subresource Integrity (SRI) by analyzing external resources.

**Category:** security

## Third-party requests

Monitor the number of third-party requests made by a website with enhanced analysis.

**Category:** privacy

## Third-party resources

Check for third-party resources loaded by the website with enhanced analysis.

**Category:** privacy

## Canonical URL

Check if the given website uses a canonical link element to avoid potential duplicate content issues.

**Category:** seo

## Load time

Check the load time of the given website with multiple measurements for accuracy.

**Category:** performance

## XSS protection

Check if the X-XSS-Protection header is present in the HTTP response headers of a website.

**Category:** security
